name: Brotherhood's End
label: Quest
description: Brotherhood's End marks the aftermath of the clandestine strike against Lord Gregor Lescovar within Stormwind Keep. With the treacherous nobleman dead…
intro: Brotherhood's End marks the aftermath of the clandestine strike against Lord Gregor Lescovar within Stormwind Keep. With the treacherous nobleman dead, Master Mathias Shaw sends you to City Architect Baros Alexston, cautioning you to keep quiet about who actually struck the killing blow.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, I almost forgot. Alexston came while you were away, he wished to speak with you. No doubt he wishes to report the goings-on of the Defias Brotherhood to the nobles.
A bit of advice, friend: if anyone should ask, I would provide all details but that it was your hand that slew Lescovar. Trust me. I am... Acquainted... With the ways of such things.
And as far as Trias goes, well, speak to no one of him... Ever... If you can help it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's good to see you, friend. I have heard that Lord Gregor Lescovar was found dead not long ago.
It would seem that you were successful in your mission. You have my gratitude that you have saved me, and many others, from VanCleef's revenge.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
